methods.what: Second-order Taylor expansion of nx - f(x) about a stationary point α where n = f'(α), giving dx in terms of dy (inverse square-root dependence)
Resulting relation between dx and dy near the stationary point
Spherical-trigonometric cosine relation for the angle β of the reflected ray
Small-angle expansion of cos β in terms of sin²(ε/2)
Limiting case ε=0, γ=0 of the reflection geometry
Projection coordinates of the reflected ray onto a plane
Expression for x as tg(δ-2α) plus a correction term
